Title: 1. Home Alone
description: An eight-year-old troublemaker, mistakenly left home alone, must defend his home against a pair of burglars on Christmas Eve.

Title: 2. Ghost
description: A slain Manhattan banker reaches out to his lover with a psychic's help.

Title: 3. Dances with Wolves
description: A lieutenant assigned to a remote Civil War outpost starts questioning his purpose after making contact with a neighboring Sioux settlement.

Title: 4. Pretty Woman
description: A corporate raider hires a hooker to act as a business escort in Beverly Hills, California.

Title: 5. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: Four humanoid turtles emerge from the sewers of New York City to fight a gang of teenage ninjas, lead by a mysterious Japanese martial artist.

Title: 6. The Hunt for Red October
description: Moscow, Washington D.C. and a CIA Analyst track a rogue Soviet Captain and his new submarine.

Title: 7. Total Recall
description: When a man goes in to have virtual vacation memories of the planet Mars implanted in his mind, an unexpected and harrowing series of events forces him to go to the planet for real - or is he?

Title: 8. Die Hard 2
description: One year after the Nakatomi Plaza incident, John McClane faces off against terrorists who seize control of Washington Dulles Airport's systems on Christmas Eve, endangering multiple incoming flights, including one carrying his wife, Holly.

Title: 9. Dick Tracy
description: The comic strip detective finds his life vastly complicated when Breathless Mahoney makes advances towards him while he is trying to battle Big Boy Caprice's united mob.

Title: 10. Kindergarten Cop
description: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher in order to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

Title: 11. Back to the Future Part III
description: Stranded in 1955, Marty McFly learns about the death of Doc Brown in 1885 and must travel back in time to save him. With no fuel readily available for the DeLorean, the two must figure how to escape the Old West before Emmett is murdered.

Title: 12. Presumed Innocent
description: As a lawyer investigates the murder of a colleague, he finds himself more connected to the crime than anyone else.

Title: 13. Days of Thunder
description: A young hot-shot stock car driver gets his chance to compete at the top level.

Title: 14. Another 48 Hrs.
description: Jack Cates once again enlists the aid of ex-con Reggie Hammond - this time to take down The Iceman, a ruthless drug lord operating in the San Francisco bay area.

Title: 15. Three Men and a Little Lady
description: Three ex-dads quickly discover how empty life is without their little lady, and go to outrageous lengths in their efforts to win their daughter back in this critically acclaimed and equally charming sequel.

Title: 16. Bird on a Wire
description: An old flame discovers her ex-boyfriend from the past is a relocated FBI informant out to stop the bad guys.

Title: 17. The Godfather Part III
description: Follows Michael Corleone, now in his 60s, as he seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

Title: 18. Flatliners
description: Five medical students experiment with "near death" experiences, until the dark consequences of past tragedies begin to jeopardize their lives.

Title: 19. Misery
description: After a famous author is rescued from a car crash by a fan of his novels, he comes to realize that the care he is receiving is only the beginning of a nightmare of captivity and abuse.

Title: 20. Edward Scissorhands
description: An unfinished creation leaves his isolated castle and enters a suburban world eager to embrace him ~ until his differences become impossible to ignore. What begins as a modern fairy tale gradually becomes a story about loneliness, beauty,

Title: 21. Problem Child
description: A young boy just short of a monster is adopted by a loving man and his wacky wife. The laughs keep coming as he pushes them to the limits.

Title: 22. Arachnophobia
description: A new species of South American killer spider hitches a lift to a California town in a coffin and starts to breed, leaving a trail of deaths that puzzle and terrify young Dr. Ross Jennings, who is newly arrived in town with his family.

Title: 23. Awakenings
description: Dr. Sayer is a pioneering neurologist who wants to take a risk and give his patients who suffer from encephalitis a drug used for Parkinson's Disease. He tries it out on one man who miraculously wakes from his perpetual catatonic state.

Title: 24. Look Who's Talking Too
description: This time, a new baby is on the way, and it's a girl. Wrapped together with the standard conflict between mother and father, Mikey engages in a bit of sibling rivalry with his new sister.

Title: 25. Hard to Kill
description: Targeted by the mob and its political supporters, hired assassins leave LAPD Detective Mason Storm for dead. Seven years later, he recovers from a deep coma, demanding justice and the opportunity to get even.

Title: 26. GoodFellas
description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mafia, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

Title: 27. Marked for Death
description: A retired DEA agent is out to hunt down and take out a Jamaican drug posse that has targeted his family and him for murder.

Title: 28. RoboCop 2
description: In bankrupt Detroit, RoboCop battles a fanatical drug lord pushing a synthetic narcotic called Nuke while OCP engineers a monstrous successor unit using the cult leader's transplanted brain.

Title: 29. Young Guns II
description: Billy the Kid and his band of outlaws are pursued across New Mexico territory by Sheriff Pat Garrett, who the young gunslingers must face-off with if they are to reach the safety of the border.

Title: 30. Gremlins 2: The New Batch
description: The Gremlins are back, and this time, they've taken control of a New York City media mogul's high-tech skyscraper.

Title: 31. Rocky V
description: Reluctantly retired from fighting, Rocky takes charge of Mickey's gym and agrees to train a young protégé who's hungry for success.

Title: 32. Joe Versus the Volcano
description: When a hypochondriac learns that he is dying, he accepts an offer to throw himself in a volcano at a tropical island, and along the way there, learns to truly live.

Title: 33. Postcards from the Edge
description: A substance-addicted actress tries to look on the bright side even as she is forced to move back in with her mother to avoid unemployment.

Title: 34. Mermaids
description: An unconventional single mother relocates with her two daughters to a small Massachusetts town in 1963, where a number of events and relationships both challenge and strengthen their familial bonds.

Title: 35. Darkman
description: A brilliant scientist left for dead returns to exact revenge on the people who burned him alive.

Title: 36. Air America
description: A young pilot finds himself recruited unwittingly into a covert and corrupt CIA airlift operation in Laos during the Vietnam conflict.

Title: 37. Predator 2
description: Los Angeles police hunt an alien creature in 1997.

Title: 38. Green Card
description: A man wanting to stay in the US enters into a marriage of convenience, but it turns into more than that.

Title: 39. Pacific Heights
description: Drake and Patty purchase a San Francisco Victorian hoping to fund their future through rental income. Their stability collapses when Carter Hayes occupies the studio, weaponizing tenant law to drain their finances and sanity.

Title: 40. Child's Play 2
description: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.

Title: 41. The Rescuers Down Under
description: R.A.S. agents Miss Bianca and Bernard race to Australia to save a little boy and a rare golden eagle from a murderous poacher.

Title: 42. Internal Affairs
description: An Internal Affairs agent becomes obsessed with bringing down a cop who has managed to maintain a spotless reputation despite being involved in a web of corruption.

Title: 43. Cadillac Man
description: Joey gets 2 days to sell 12 cars to keep his job and keep his girlfriends happy. It gets worse. He's juggling 3 buyers when a guy with a machine gun crashes into the car dealership and takes everybody hostage.

Title: 44. Memphis Belle
description: In 1943, the crew of a B-17 based in the UK prepares for its 25th and final bombing mission over Germany before returning home to the USA.

Title: 45. House Party
description: Kid decides to go to his friend Play's house party, but neither of them can predict what's in store for them on what could be the wildest night of their lives.

Title: 46. Jacob's Ladder
description: Reminiscing about his dead son, a Vietnam War veteran attempts to uncover his past while suffering from a severe case of dissociation. To do so, he must decipher reality and life from his own dreams, delusions, and perceptions of death.

Title: 47. The Exorcist III
description: A police lieutenant uncovers more than he bargained for as his investigation of a series of murders, which have all the hallmarks of the deceased Gemini serial killer, leads him to question the patients of a psychiatric ward.

Title: 48. Navy Seals
description: A battle-hardened SEAL Team set off on a mission to destroy a shipment of US-built Stinger missiles that have fallen into terrorist hands.

Title: 49. Ernest Goes to Jail
description: Ernest P. Worrell is a bank janitor sent to jail when people mistake his identity for a look-alike.

Title: 50. Ghost Dad
description: A widowed father tries to support his children after he becomes a ghost in an accident.

Title: 51. Lionheart
description: An Ex-French Soldier begins participating in underground street fights in order to make money for his brother's family.

Title: 52. My Blue Heaven
description: An all too uptight FBI agent must protect a larger than life mobster with a heart of gold, currently under witness protection in the suburbs.

Title: 53. The Russia House
description: Bartholomew "Barley" Scott Blair, a British publisher torn between moral conviction and self-preservation, is drawn into MI5 and CIA surveillance as he pursues a mysterious Russian contact tied to nuclear manuscript intelligence stakes.

Title: 54. The First Power
description: A Los Angeles policeman hunts a killer brought back by Satan.

Title: 55. The Rookie
description: A veteran detective is assigned a rookie partner after his previous partner is killed by a car theft gang. He is determined to apprehend those responsible for his friend's death but his new partner isn't really up to the task.

Title: 56. The Freshman
description: An N.Y.C. film school student accepts a job with a local mobster who resembles a famous cinema godfather and who takes the young man under his wing, after demanding total loyalty.

Title: 57. The Adventures of Ford Fairlane
description: A vulgar private detective is hired to find a missing groupie and is drawn into a mystery involving a series of murders tied to the music industry.

Title: 58. Quigley Down Under
description: Sharpshooter Matt Quigley is hired from Wyoming by an Australian rancher paying a very high price. But when Quigley arrives Down Under, all is not as it seems.

Title: 59. Madhouse
description: The luxurious villa of yuppie couple Mark and Jessie Bannister is overrun by loads of uninvited guests who turn the house upside-down and nearly destroy it.

Title: 60. Hamlet
description: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, finds out that his uncle Claudius killed his father to obtain the throne, and plans revenge.

Title: 61. Jetsons: The Movie
description: George Jetson is forced to uproot his family when Mr. Spacely promotes him to take charge of a new factory on a distant planet.

Title: 62. Stella
description: Chronicling a strong, but eccentric woman's devoted relationship to her daughter through the years.

Title: 63. Taking Care of Business
description: Lives are turned upside down when a corporate businessman loses his leather datebook in an airport.

Title: 64. Betsy's Wedding
description: The very different fashion student Betsy Hopper and investment banker Jake Lovell are getting married. They want a small wedding but their fathers want to give them a much more elaborate celebration.

Title: 65. DuckTales: The Movie - Treasure of the Lost Lamp
description: Scrooge McDuck takes Huey, Dewey, and Louie to Egypt to find a pyramid and magic lamp.

Title: 66. Sibling Rivalry
description: A frustrated woman's life gets even more frustrating once she gets into an affair with a man who suffers a fatal heart attack after their fling.

Title: 67. White Palace
description: Lust turns to love for a 40-ish working-class woman and a 20-ish yuppie adman with little in common.

Title: 68. The NeverEnding Story II: The Next Chapter
description: A young boy with a distant father enters a world of make-believe and magic through a portal within an antique book.

Title: 69. The Guardian
description: A young couple with a newborn son don't realize that their new nanny is a magical Druid sacrificing infants to an evil tree.

Title: 70. Death Warrant
description: An undercover operative infiltrates a state prison to investigate mysterious inmate deaths, only to find his psychopathic nemesis has been transferred into the same facility to execute him on behalf of a corrupt official.

Title: 71. Tremors
description: Inhabitants of a small isolated town defend themselves against strange underground creatures which are killing them one by one.

Title: 72. Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
description: To stall a witch plotting to eat him, a boy reads her horror tales dealing with a collegian's resurrection of a mummy, a murderous cat, and an artist's pact with a gargoyle.

Title: 73. Men at Work
description: Two garbage men uncover a conspiracy involving illegal toxic waste dumping and decide to bring the whole operation down.

Title: 74. I Love You to Death
description: Joey Boca (Kevin Kline) owns a pizza parlor, and is married to Rosalie (Tracey Ullman). He's also a serial womanizer. Rosalie goes to extremes when she finds he has been cheating.

Title: 75. Mo' Better Blues
description: Jazz trumpeter Bleek Gilliam makes questionable decisions in his professional and romantic lives.

Title: 76. Avalon
description: A Polish-Jewish family comes to the U.S. at the beginning of the twentieth century. There, the family and their children try to make themselves a better future in the so-called promised land.

Title: 77. The Bonfire of the Vanities
description: After his mistress runs over a young teen, a Wall Street hotshot sees his life unravel in the spotlight and attracts the interest of a down-and-out reporter.

Title: 78. Revenge
description: A retired US Navy pilot comes to Mexico, where he falls in love with the wife of a powerful businessman. The consequences will be cruel and unforeseen.

Title: 79. Reversal of Fortune
description: Wealthy Sunny von Bülow lies brain-dead, husband Claus guilty of attempted murder; but he says he's innocent and hires Alan Dershowitz for his appeal.

Title: 80. Mr. Destiny
description: Unhappy Larry Burrows sees what his life could have been like if he had made that winning home run as a teenager.

Title: 81. Spaced Invaders
description: Dimwitted Martians drop into a little Illinois town on the day that the local radio station happens to rebroadcast Orson Welles 1938 "War Of The Worlds".

Title: 82. Quick Change
description: Three thieves successfully rob a New York City bank, but making the escape from the city proves to be almost impossible.

Title: 83. Shipwrecked
description: A young Norwegian boy in 1850s England goes to work as a cabin boy and discovers some of his shipmates are actually pirates.

Title: 84. Fire Birds
description: Elite Apache helicopter pilots are tasked with destroying powerful armed drug cartels operating in South America.

Title: 85. Wild at Heart
description: Young lovers Sailor and Lula run from the variety of weirdos that Lula's mom has hired to kill Sailor.

Title: 86. Lord of the Flies
description: Stranded on an island, a group of schoolboys degenerate into savagery.

Title: 87. The Grifters
description: A conman makes a no-win triangle with his mom and his girlfriend.

Title: 88. Crazy People
description: A bitter ad executive who has reached his breaking point lands in a mental institution, where his career actually begins to thrive with help from his fellow patients.

Title: 89. Bad Influence
description: A timid Los Angeles executive falls under the influence of a charismatic drifter who weaponizes sex, humiliation, and violence to dismantle every fragile structure holding the man's identity together.

Title: 90. Graveyard Shift
description: The owner of an ancient mill hires a drifter to rid the basement of rats.

Title: 91. Henry & June
description: Anaïs Nin meets American writer Henry Miller in Paris in 1931. She keeps a diary of her sexual awakening, which includes Henry and his wife June.

Title: 92. Pump Up the Volume
description: Mark runs a pirate radio station and causes an uproar when he speaks his mind and enthralls fellow teens.

Title: 93. Opportunity Knocks
description: Two con men hide out in a house while the owner is away; one of them assumes the identity of the absent house sitter when the owner's relatives come to visit, only for further complications to set in.

Title: 94. Q&A
description: Dirty cop Mike Brennan thinks he got away with murder. But during a routine Q&A, the righteous assistant DA finds a clue that sets them both on a collision course.

Title: 95. Nuns on the Run
description: Two criminals want out--but their boss kills those leaving. When the men are ordered to rob the triad, they keep the money and hide from the boss, the Triad, and the police at a convent, dressed as nuns.

Title: 96. Narrow Margin
description: A Los Angeles Deputy District Attorney is sent to protect a woman who accidentally witnessed a Mafia murder.

Title: 97. The Witches
description: A young boy stumbles onto a witch convention and must stop them, even after he has been turned into a mouse.

Title: 98. The Two Jakes
description: The sequel to Chinatown (1974) finds J.J. "Jake" Gittes investigating adultery and murder, and the money that comes from oil.

Title: 99. Miami Blues
description: An ex-con's first act of freedom is moving to Miami where he restarts his old criminal ways with even more potency.

Title: 100. Havana
description: In 1950s Cuba, a professional gambler falls for a woman heavily involved in the revolution movement.

Title: 101. Nightbreed
description: A troubled young man is drawn to a mythical place called Midian where a variety of friendly monsters are hiding from humanity. Meanwhile, a sadistic serial killer is looking for a patsy.

Title: 102. Ski Patrol
description: A developer attempts to sabotage the safety record of a ski resort.

Title: 103. Cry-Baby
description: In 1950s Baltimore, a bad boy with a heart of gold wins the love of a good girl, whose boyfriend sets out for revenge.

Title: 104. Blue Steel
description: A rookie in the police force must engage in a cat-and-mouse game with a pistol-wielding psychopath who becomes obsessed with her.

Title: 105. Funny About Love
description: NYC cartoonist Duffy meets the bad cappuccino maker, chef Meg, and falls in love. She moves in with him, marries him - but they have problems having a baby.

Title: 106. Mr. & Mrs. Bridge
description: Set during World War II, an upper-class family begins to fall apart due to the conservative nature of the patriarch and the progressive values of his children.

Title: 107. Alice
description: A spoiled Manhattan housewife re-evaluates her life after visiting a Chinatown healer.

Title: 108. Almost an Angel
description: A small-time crook becomes convinced he is an angel after a traumatic incident and resolves to perform God's work to make good things happen.

Title: 109. Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
description: When DEA agents are taken captive by a ruthless South American kingpin, the Delta Force is reunited to rescue them in this sequel to the 1986 film.

Title: 110. Flashback
description: At last the Feds have caught him! Infamous 60's radical Huey Walker is heading for jail. So how come it's Huey's yuptight FBI escort who ends up behind bars?

Title: 111. Men Don't Leave
description: Jessica Lange plays Beth in this warm-hearted, funny fable about staying together when all else is falling apart.

Title: 112. Night of the Living Dead
description: When the unburied dead return to life and seek human victims, seven refugees shelter in a house in the Pennsylvanian countryside.

Title: 113. Cyrano de Bergerac
description: Famed swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac is in love with his cousin Roxane. He has never expressed his love for her as he his large nose undermines his self-confidence. Then he finds a way to express his love to her, indirectly.

Title: 114. Stanley & Iris
description: A struggling widow falls in love with an illiterate short-order cook whom she teaches to read and write in her kitchen each night.

Title: 115. Leatherface: Texas Chainsaw Massacre III
description: A California couple and a survivalist encounter Leatherface and his family.

Title: 116. Hardware
description: The head of a cyborg reactivates, rebuilds itself, and goes on a violent rampage in a space marine's girlfriend's apartment.

Title: 117. Loose Cannons
description: An unconventional cop who takes no bull is paired up with an amazing detective to capture some powerful criminals, but the cop soon realizes that his by-the-book partner has split-personality disorder.

Title: 118. Europa Europa
description: A boy in Nazi Germany, trying to conceal that he is Jewish, joins the Hitler Youth.

Title: 119. Miller's Crossing
description: Tom Reagan, an advisor to a Prohibition-era crime boss, tries to keep the peace between warring mobs but gets caught in divided loyalties.

Title: 120. La Femme Nikita
description: Convicted felon Nikita isn't going to jail; she's given a new identity and trained, stylishly, as a top secret spy/assassin.

Title: 121. The Handmaid's Tale
description: Under a dystopian religious tyranny, most women cannot conceive children. Those young women who can live in a form of sexual slavery to provide children for influential families.

Title: 122. The Long Walk Home
description: Two women in 1955 Montgomery, Alabama, one Black and one white, must decide how they will respond to the famous bus boycott led by Martin Luther King.

Title: 123. Graffiti Bridge
description: The unofficial sequel to 'Purple Rain' (1984). The Kid is now club owner and rival to Morris (Morris Day), with whom he gets into a fight for the Glam Slam Nightclub.

Title: 124. I Come in Peace
description: A renegade cop is forced to work with an FBI agent in order to bring down a group of drug dealers with sinister plans.

Title: 125. Lisa
description: A flirtatious teenager with an eye for older men gets more than she bargained for when the handsome stranger she's pursuing turns out to be a serial killer.

Title: 126. Lambada
description: During the day, Kevin Laird teaches at a select Beverly Hills high school. At night, however, he sets fire to the dance floor at a lambada club in East Los Angeles.

Title: 127. China Cry: A True Story
description: This is the true story of Sung Neng Yee, now known as Nora Lam, who fled from Communist China to Hong Kong for her palpably real Christian faith.

Title: 128. Heart Condition
description: A racist cop receives a heart transplant from a black lawyer he hates, who returns as a ghost to ask the cop to help take down the men who murdered him.

Title: 129. Mountains of the Moon
description: The legendary true-story of Capt. Richard Francis Burton and Lt. John Hanning Speke's tumultuous expedition to find the source of the Nile river.

Title: 130. Short Time
description: When a police detective thinks he is dying and learns that his life insurance pays out more if he dies in the line of duty, he tries to make that happen.

Title: 131. Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael
description: A small town prepares for the homecoming of superstar Roxy Carmichael, as does a young outsider who believes Roxy is her mother.

Title: 132. Paris Is Burning
description: A chronicle of New York's drag scene in the 1980s, focusing on balls, voguing and the ambitions and dreams of those who gave the era its warmth and vitality.

Title: 133. A Shock to the System
description: When electrocuted by the basement fuse box at home, Graham Marshall develops sinister ideas concerning both his nagging wife Leslie and his colleague Robert Benham, who was given Graham's promotion at their corporate office.

Title: 134. Metropolitan
description: A group of young upper-class Manhattanites are blithely passing through the gala debutante season, when an unusual outsider joins them and stirs them up.

Title: 135. The Judas Project
description: How would you react if Christ had re-appeared on earth today? Would man kind repeat their mistakes or accept? This movie is about a modernized 2nd coming of Christ. Instead of facing Romans there are different obstacles in these modern times that he'd have to face.

Title: 136. Desperate Hours
description: An escaped con, on the run from the law, moves into a married couple's house and takes over their lives.

Title: 137. After Dark, My Sweet
description: After he escapes from a mental hospital, a former boxer works for a widow. When she asks him to get involved in a kidnapping, he has second thoughts.

Title: 138. King of New York
description: A drug kingpin is released from prison and seeks to take total control of the criminal underworld in order to give back to the community.

Title: 139. Impulse
description: Lottie is a vice cop in LA posing as a hooker and likes the action. She meets Stan, who's also single. He needs her for a major drug bust.

Title: 140. Class of 1999
description: Three ex-military robots are reprogrammed as teachers and secretly placed in a school where most students are part of organized gangs. They begin to respond violently to unruly students, and their military training starts to take over.

Title: 141. Body Chemistry
description: A research project on sexual response leads two doctors into an affair where their deepest passions and darkest fantasies are revealed.

Title: 142. Downtown
description: An eager rookie cop gets transferred to a tough downtown Philadelphia precinct after stopping a powerful man for traffic violations. When his old cop buddy is murdered, he wants in on catching the killer.

Title: 143. White Hunter Black Heart
description: A thinly fictionalized account of legendary movie director John Huston whose desire to hunt an elephant turns into a grim situation with his movie crew during the making of The African Queen.

Title: 144. The Nasty Girl
description: When a young woman investigates her town's Nazi past, the community turns against her.

Title: 145. Texasville
description: The summer of 1984: 32 years after Duane Jackson captained the high school football team and Jacy Farrow was homecoming queen, the small town of Anarene, Texas prepares for its centennial celebration. Oil prices are down, banks are failing, and Duane's $12 million in debt. His wife Karla drinks too much, his children are always in trouble, and he tom-cats around with the wives of friends. Jacy's back in town, after a mildly successful acting career, life in Italy, and the death of her son. People assume Duane and Jacy will resume their high school romance. And Sonny is "tired in his mind," causing worries for his safety. Can these friends find equilibrium in middle age?

Title: 146. Vincent & Theo
description: The familiar tragic story of Vincent van Gogh is broadened by focusing as well on his brother Theodore, who helped support Vincent. The movie also provides a nice view of the locations which Vincent painted.

Title: 147. Def by Temptation
description: An evil succubus is preying on libidinous black men in New York City, and all that stands in her way is a minister-in-training, an aspiring actor, and a cop who specializes in cases involving the supernatural.

Title: 148. Eating
description: A group of young and middle-aged women gather for the birthday party of a friend and talk about their lives and food they cook for their husbands, boyfriends, or themselves.

Title: 149. The Sheltering Sky
description: An American couple travel abroad to revitalize their relationship. But as the trip drags on, their attempt at recovering what they once had seems futile.

Title: 150. Cadence
description: A young, fiercely independent Army Private is thrust into a work-camp stockade where he discovers the value of friendship and loyalty in the face of a dangerous enemy from a dynamic group of black prisoners.

Title: 151. Gate 2: The Trespassers
description: Four teens summon forth a diminuitive, demonic minion from The Other Side to do their bidding and grant their wishes, but of course, they must all ultimately pay the price...

Title: 152. Ju Dou
description: In rural China, the young bride of a tyrannical owner of a silk-dyeing business finds temporary solace in the arms of her husband's nephew, but problems arise when she becomes pregnant.

Title: 153. Dreams
description: A collection of tales based upon eight of director Akira Kurosawa's recurring dreams.

Title: 154. State of Grace
description: An undercover officer rejoins Irish mob pals in Hell's Kitchen.

Title: 155. The Forbidden Dance
description: A Brazilian princess tries to save the rain forests by introducing the world to the electrifying exotic lambada.

Title: 156. Tune in Tomorrow...
description: New Orleans, 1951: A law student, working at WXBU radio station, falls in love with his cute aunt, who's looking for a third husband. Then Pedro starts writing radio series at WXBU, stirring up things.

Title: 157. The Nutcracker Prince
description: An adaption of the classic tale of a girl's dreams turned reality when her new toy turns out to be a young man placed under a curse.

Title: 158. Everybody's Fine
description: Matteo decides to take a trip across Italy to go visiting his five children.

Title: 159. My Father's Glory
description: At the end of the nineteenth century, little Marcel lives with his parents in the Provence countryside. During his holiday, Marcel meets Lili, a local boy who knows all the secrets of the hills, and the two become fast friends.

Title: 160. The Rain Killer
description: Together, a weary cop and an all-business FBI agent team up to catch the latest homicidal maniac: the Rain Killer. Just when they think that all the clues have been washed away, they find the one last clue-the one that's been in plain sight.

Title: 161. Brain Dead
description: In a showdown of man versus machine, Martin plunges into a chaotic nightmare trying to save his mind from the megalomaniacal corporation.

Title: 162. May Fools
description: During the events of May 1968 in France, different worldviews of conflicting relatives collide in their family estate.

Title: 163. Truly Madly Deeply
description: A woman dealing with inconsolable grief over the death of her partner gets another chance when he returns to earth as a ghost.

Title: 164. The Haunting of Morella
description: Loosely based on the short story by Edgar Allan Poe, a witch is sent to death, only to try & return from the grave, seventeen years later, to possess her daughter's adult body.

Title: 165. The Last of the Finest
description: 4 LA cops are fighting the war on drugs. Corrupt superiors manage to break up their team when one of them gets killed. The 3 quit LAPD and continue investigating.

Title: 166. Life Is Sweet
description: A shop assistant, her cook husband, and their twin daughters go about their lives in a working-class London suburb.

Title: 167. Streets
description: The story of runaways living in Venice, California, under the threat of a psychotic cop who is a serial killer of prostitutes.

Title: 168. A Cry in the Wild
description: Adapted from Gary Paulsen's novel "Hatchet", a boy crash-lands in Canada's bear country and survives with a hatchet his divorced mother gave him.

Title: 169. The Field
description: When a field (which has been farmed by the McCabe family for generations) goes up for auction, the patriarch of the McCabe family will stop at nothing to prevent a rich American from buying it.

Title: 170. My Mother's Castle
description: Every holiday Marcel and his family go to their cottage near Marseilles. During one of these holidays he meets Isabelle, a pretty but conceited girl... Adapted from the cult classic novel from Marcel Pagnol.

Title: 171. Mister Johnson
description: In 1923, a local resident of British Colonial Nigeria tries to be equal with the colonial administration.

Title: 172. Love at Large
description: Vampish miss Dolan hires hardboiled P.I. Harry Dobbs to tail her shady boyfriend. Harry realizes that the man leads a double life but then his client disappears. Harry teams up with his own tail, P.I. Stella Wynkowski, to clear things up.

Title: 173. Repossessed
description: Parody of The Exorcist (1973), with Linda Blair once again possessed by Satan and Leslie Nielsen as the exorcist.

Title: 174. Book of Love
description: A reminiscence of youth in the 1950's.

Title: 175. Daddy's Dyin'... Who's Got the Will?
description: Bickering siblings are reunited at their Texas home as their father lies on his deathbed.

Title: 176. Everybody Wins
description: Angela (Debra Winger) hires/lures a P.I. (Nick Nolte) to prove a convicted teenager is innocent of his uncle's murder.

Title: 177. The Fourth War
description: Cold War drama about two gung-ho border commanders (Roy Scheider, Jurgen Prochnow) who carry out their own private war against each other on the German - Czechoslovakia border.

Title: 178. The Hot Spot
description: Upon arriving to a small town, a drifter quickly gets into trouble with the local authorities - and the local women - after he robs a bank.

Title: 179. Bloodfist II
description: Kickboxing champion Jake Raye thought his fighting days were over, until a call from an old friend draws him to the Far East and into the hands of a madman. This time Jake's fighting for his life!

Title: 180. The Comfort of Strangers
description: Colin and Mary retreat to Venice to work on their relationship, but an encounter with lyrical local bar owner Robert and his odd, sexually frank wife Caroline leads them into a world of intrigue where their darkest desires are in reach.

Title: 181. Slumber Party Massacre III
description: Jackie Cassidy and her friends are stalked by a serial killer while having a slumber party.

Title: 182. Slacker
description: A day in the life of Austin, Texas as the camera roams from place to place and provides a brief look at the overeducated, the social misfits, the outcasts and the oddballs.

Title: 183. Vital Signs
description: The story of a group of third-year students at a Los Angeles medical school and their struggles with love, their studies and one another.

Title: 184. Without You I'm Nothing
description: Sandra Bernhard stars in a studio version of her off-Broadway show, blending re-enactments of the original show's pieces with concept vignettes and 'testimonials' to underscore the relationship between a performer and an audience.

Title: 185. The Hairdresser's Husband
description: Antoine has always been fascinated by a hairdresser's delicate touch, the beguiling perfume and the enticing figure of a woman with an opulent bosom. After all, he always knew he would marry one, completing his idealised love fantasy.

Title: 186. The Krays
description: This fact-based movie follows the life of the twin crime-lords in London's '60s underworld.

Title: 187. The Boyfriend School
description: Cartoonist Gus has survived cancer treatment and now his romance novelist sister tries to find him a woman and guide him. Will they succeed?

Title: 188. To Sleep with Anger
description: A charismatic old acquaintance drifts into town, stirring up trouble for a mild-mannered family.

Title: 189. Daddy Nostalgia
description: A retired English businessman has just been through heart surgery but it has, apparently, done little to relieve his constant pain or improve his long-term survival prospects.

Title: 190. Where the Heart Is
description: A wealthy businessman shows his young-adult offspring how tough life can be.

Title: 191. An Angel at My Table
description: Janet Frame was a brilliant child who, as a teen, was misdiagnosed with schizophrenia. Explore Janet's discovery of the world and her life in Europe as her books are published to acclaim.

Title: 192. Hidden Agenda
description: When an American human rights lawyer is assassinated in Belfast, it remains for the man's girlfriend, as well as a tough, no nonsense, police detective to find the truth.

Title: 193. Corporate Affairs
description: In the frantic world of Wall Street, four top executives have a small problem with their boss: he's dead. Now they've got to hide his body for the next 24 hours to pull off the deal of the century, in this 1990 flick, curiously similar to 1989's, Weekend At Bernie's.

Title: 194. Come See the Paradise
description: The passionate romance between an Irish-American man and a Japanese-American woman is threatened when the Pearl Harbor attacks happen and the woman is forced into a prison camp because of her ethnicity.

Title: 195. Angel Town
description: French exchange student and martial arts expert Jacques (Olivier Gruner) utilizes his skills when he has to protect a landlord and her son from a gang of ruthless criminals in a run-down urban setting.

Title: 196. Waiting for the Light
description: After inheriting a diner, Garr moves her family from the city. Her kids learn tricks from Aunt Zena and get expelled. Garr threatens orphanages for kids and asylum for Aunt Z if pranks continue.

Title: 197. C'est la vie
description: The July 1958 vacation, on a beach on the Atlantic coast. Little Sophie, 8 years old, and her big sister Frédérique suffer from the bad understanding between their parents, presenting the drama of divorce which will not fail to occur.

Title: 198. Listen Up: The Lives of Quincy Jones
description: A unique look at the legendary musician, arranger, composer and producer offers a collage of memories, sounds and intimate interviews with musical greats in a rousing showcase.

Title: 199. Mindwalk
description: Philosophical conversations between a poet, politician, and scientist.

Title: 200. Rosencrantz & Guildenstern Are Dead
description: Two minor characters from the play 'Hamlet' stumble around unaware of their scripted lives and unable to deviate from them.

Title: 201. Thousand Pieces of Gold
description: In 1880s China, a girl is sold into marriage by her father. Rather than becoming a bride, Lalu ends up in a gold-mining town where she forges a path for her own freedom and, ultimately, true love.

Title: 202. Coupe de Ville
description: Three bickering brothers who don't get along reluctantly go on a cross-country road trip together to deliver a car in time for their mother's birthday.

Title: 203. The Return of Superfly
description: In this action-packed sequel, a retired drug dealer living in Paris discovers his old partner has been killed and returns to NY to avenge his murder.

Title: 204. Auntie Danielle
description: Auntie Danielle, supposedly in ailing health but in reality just a nasty old bitch, lives with a paid housekeeper who she regularly abuses. When the housekeeper dies falling off a ladder, Danielle moves in with her great-nephew and his family. She continues using her nastiness to manipulate everyone into doing things her way until the family goes on vacation to Greece. The young housekeeper they hire to watch after her knows what Auntie is doing, and deals with her accordingly, and they begin forming respect for each other.

Title: 205. Overexposed
description: Morrison (from Larry Brand's The Drifter) makes his return. In this film he must figure out who's stalking the star of a soap opera, and do everything to protect her once he does.

Title: 206. Strike It Rich
description: A London accountant on his honeymoon gets swept away by gambling fever.

Title: 207. Meet the Applegates
description: Modelling themselves after an idyllic cookie-cutter suburban 1950s family, a colony of insects move from South America into the United States with the intent of getting access to the nation's nuclear resources.

Title: 208. American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
description: The two American Ninjas, Joe Armstrong and Sean Davidson, team up to do battle against a terrorist and his band of Ninjas.

Title: 209. Trust
description: Two young misfits with a troubled home life find each other.

Title: 210. Iron & Silk
description: Mark Salzman always was interested in Kung-Fu and the Chinese culture, claims to have seen every Kung-Fu movie. 1982, with a degree in Chinese literature, he visits a province university in China for two years to teach Chinese teachers the English language. He learns the refinements of correct behavior among Chinese people, makes friends with his pupils, falls in love with the young doctor Ming, learns Wushu (similar Kung-Fu) from the famous teacher Pan... but also learns about political repression, especially when he's forbidden contact with some of his friends.

Title: 211. Two Evil Eyes
description: A duo of Edgar Allan Poe adaptations about a greedy wife's attempt to embezzle her dying husband's fortune, and a sleazy reporter's adoption of a strange black cat.

Title: 212. Frankenstein Unbound
description: The ultimate weapon, which was meant to be safe for mankind, produces global side effects including time slides and disappearances. The scientist behind the project, and his car, are zapped from the year 2031 to 1817's Switzerland.

Title: 213. American Dream
description: Recounts the 1985-86 strike against the Hormel Foods Corporation in Minnesota after its employees' wages and benefits were cut.

Title: 214. Pastime
description: Pastime is a story of an aging, white pitcher on a minor league baseball team who takes a young, talented, black pitcher under his wing in 1957.

Title: 215. Journey of Hope
description: The story of a Turkish Alevi family trying to illegally emigrate to Switzerland, a country they know only from a postcard.

Title: 216. Closet Land
description: In a drab police state, an author of children's books is interrogated by a sadistic, secret policeman because she's under suspicion of embedding anti-government messages in her stories.

Title: 217. Terminal Bliss
description: Two adolescent children of wealthy parents deal with the emotional travails of spoiled youth by indulging in self destructive behavior including but not limited to drugs, parties and teen sex. Friends John (Luke Perry) and Alex (Timothy Owen) deal with issues of betrayal involving Alex's girlfriend Stevie (Estee Chandler).

Title: 218. Frankenhooker
description: A medical student sets out to recreate his decapitated fiancée by building her a new body made of Manhattan street prostitutes.

Title: 219. Bright Angel
description: Road-movie from Montana to Wyoming. A gullible, innocent young man (Mulroney) assists a versatile girl (Taylor) on her long quest to get her brother out of jail.

Title: 220. Days of Being Wild
description: A man tries to find out who his real mother is after the woman who raised him tells him the truth.

Title: 221. Men of Respect
description: It's Macbeth in mobster form!

Title: 222. Open Doors
description: A principled judge faces a case that society demands capital punishment for.

Title: 223. A Man Called Sarge
description: The French Foreign Legion will never be the same after the uproarious World War II exploits of Sgt. Duke Roscoe and his band of military misfits. It's a hilarious "war movie" that will leave you shell-shocked with laughter.

Title: 224. A Show of Force
description: An American journalist in Puerto Rico in 1978 investigates the death of nationalists who may have been murdered by the police.

Title: 225. Chicago Joe and the Showgirl
description: During World War II, an American serviceman in London decides to impress his English girlfriend by acting as an American gangster, which soon turns deadly.

Title: 226. Why Me?
description: A jewel thief steals a sacred ruby which sets off a chase by the police, the Turkish government, nutty Armenian terrorists, and the C.I.A.

Title: 227. Fools of Fortune
description: A Protestant Irish family is caught up in a conflict between Irish Republicans and the British army.

Title: 228. Naked Tango
description: When a young European woman assumes a false identity in 1920s Argentina, she gets more than she bargained for.

Title: 229. The Third Animation Celebration: The Movie
description: The best films chosen from the Third Los Angeles International Animation Celebration and the popular theatrical tour.

Title: 230. Crossing the Line
description: Unemployed Scottish miner Danny Scoular (Liam Neeson) is forced into bare-knuckle boxing to make ends meet.

Title: 231. Blood Oath
description: The island of Ambon in Indonesia, 1945. During the War, the number of Australian POWs on the island had dropped from 1100 to less than 300 due to abuses by their Japanese captors. Capt. Cooper is the chief prosecutor. In a mass grave, the bodies of 300 executed servicemen have been unearthed. Cooper assumes that the massacre was ordered by Baron Takahashi, Japanese commander on Ambon. But the one potential witness has gone mad and is due to be shipped back to Australia. No captured airmen were found alive on the island at all, not even the four-man crew of a reconnaissance plane shot down late in the War. Takahashi is returned to the island in the custody of an American officer, Maj. Beckett. But there is little evidence with which to prosecute the Baron. Cooper thinks he could make a case for the missing airmen if only their bodies could be located. And why does Maj. Beckett appear interested in not seeing Takahashi convicted? Cooper gets a break when Lt. Tanaka, a communications officer and a Christian, surrenders himself...

Title: 232. The Spirit of '76
description: In 2176, a magnetic storm erases all recorded history, including the U.S. Constitution, so, three time travelers are sent back to July 4, 1776, to retrieve the heritage, but end up in 1976's Bicentennial, while being perceived as aliens.

Title: 233. The Reflecting Skin
description: In the 1950s, a young boy living with his troublesome family in rural USA fantasizes that a neighboring widow is actually a vampire, responsible for a number of disappearances in the area.

Title: 234. Paper Mask
description: A lowly hospital orderly impersonates a recently deceased doctor, and goes to work in the busy ER of a small hospital. There, he meets and befriends a nurse who slowly figures out his secret and helps him maintain his charade.

Title: 235. Resident Alien
description: At age 73, writer and melancholy master of the bon mot, Quentin Crisp (1908-1999), became an Englishman in New York. Rossiter's camera follows Crisp about the streets of Manhattan, where Crisp seems very much at home, wearing eye shadow, appearing on a makeshift stage, making and repeating wry observations, talking to John Hurt (who played Crisp in the autobiographical TV movie, "The Naked Civil Servant"), and dining with friends. Others who know Crisp comment on him, on his life as an openly gay man with an effeminate manner, and on his place in the history of gays' social struggle. The portrait that emerges is of one wit and of suffering.

Title: 236. The Fall of Otrar
description: This historical epic charts political intrigue among the Kipchaks, a confederation of tribes on the steppes of Central Asia, before they were overrun by Genghis Khan.

Title: 237. The Garden
description: A nearly wordless visual narrative inter cuts two main stories and a couple of minor ones.

Title: 238. Close-Up
description: The true story of Hossain Sabzian, a cinephile who impersonated the director Mohsen Makhmalbaf to convince a family they would star in his so-called new film.

Title: 239. The Ages of Lulu
description: The story of a young woman's descent into the kinky and dangerous sexual underground in Madrid.

Title: 240. Troll 2
description: A vacationing family discovers that the entire town they're visiting is inhabited by goblins, disguised as humans, who plan to eat them.

Title: 241. Sorority House Massacre II
description: Five college women buy the old Hokstedter place for their new sorority house. They decide to stay in it for the night to meet the movers in the morning, but begin to get the creeps when the weird neighbor starts poking around.

Title: 242. 1001 Nights
description: Zany subversion of the 1001 Nights myth that skips all of the stories and simply focuses on the lovely Scheherazade's escape from the lustful king with the help of a magic lamp and a time traveling astrologist.

Title: 243. Bullet in the Head
description: When three close friends escape from Hong Kong to war-time Saigon to start a criminal's life, they all go through a harrowing experience which totally shatters their lives and their friendship forever.

Title: 244. The Ambulance
description: A comic-book artist meets a woman on the NYC streets, but after a quick flirtation, she suddenly collapses and is picked up by an old ambulance. He checks all the hospitals in the area, but the woman has disappeared.

Title: 245. Hard to Die
description: Five lingerie models are terrorized by a series of murders in their office building. They suspect the janitor who witnessed past killings, unaware of the real horror awaiting them.

Title: 246. Halfaouine: Boy of the Terraces
description: Noura struggles to reconcile two worlds, Muslim women and men, while also dealing with his own sexuality.

Title: 247. The Invisible Maniac
description: An invisible scientist escapes from an asylum and teaches high-school physics to nubile teens.

Title: 248. Singapore Sling
description: A man searching for his long-lost lover is kidnapped by her killers, an insane, mother-daughter duo, and they force him to commit various sexual atrocities with them.

Title: 249. Maniac Cop 2
description: A supernatural, maniac killer cop teams up with a Times Square serial killer.

Title: 250. Demon Wind
description: With the need to investigate the mysterious death of his grandparents, Cory and his friends assemble back to the old farm where it all began, sixty years earlier.

Title: 251. The Exorcist III: Legion
description: William Peter Blatty's director's cut of "The Exorcist III" which was thought to be lost. Recovered and released in 2016 under its original title, this is the definitive cut of the film based on his novel "Legion".

Title: 252. Moon 44
description: An unconventional corporate agent is given the task of shaping a group of violent criminals and technical wizards into a helicopter defense force assigned to protect a mining station on a remote moon.

Title: 253. The Death King
description: Seven episodes, each taking place on a different day of the week, on the theme of suicide and violent death.

Title: 254. The Juniper Tree
description: Margit and her older sister, Katla, flee their homeland after their mother is killed for practicing witchcraft. Needing a place to stay, Katla casts a spell over a young farmer named Jóhann which makes him fall in love with her.

Title: 255. Catchfire
description: A witness to a mob assassination flees for her life, running from town to town and switching identities along the way, but she cannot seem to elude Milo, the chief hit man sent after her.

Title: 256. Bride of Re-Animator
description: Doctors Herbert West and Dan Cain discover the secret to creating human life and proceed to create a perfect woman from dead tissue.

Title: 257. The Rift
description: Siren II, a submarine under the command of Capt. Phillips, ventures into the deep on a mission to recover the missing Siren I. Their quest is hindered when the submarine becomes entangled in a patch of toxic seaweed.

Title: 258. Erotic Ghost Story
description: Three women who are Taoist devotees are tricked by the Wu-Tung demon into following their sexual desires.

Title: 259. Mirror Mirror
description: A teenage girl begins receiving black magic power through an antique mirror that drips blood, not realizing the mirror is controlled by demonic forces.

Title: 260. Red Dawn
description: A Claustrophobic experience which involves a Mexican middle class family into the atrocities made by wild and heartless army forces whose main objective seems to be students who do not permit the 1968's Olimpic games' to develop normally.

Title: 261. The Match Factory Girl
description: A woman's terribly dull life is upended by a one-night stand pregnancy, causing her to seek retribution.

Title: 262. Against the Wind
description: Juan flees Madrid and an incestuous relationship with his sister, Ana, working at a mine on the Andalucian coast. When his friendship with Rosario, a local shop girl, becomes romance, Ana shows up wanting to rekindle their affair. He resists at first, but she stays, asserting that Juan is the only man she can ever love. Juan distances himself from Rosario. The mine has problems: high cancer rates in the area caused by poorly stored radioactive waste. A foreign safety engineer, Petersen, tries to connect with Ana, is rebuffed, but lets her stay in his sea-front bungalow. Juan seeks her out to demand she leave, only to argue with Petersen. Death, desire, and longing play out.

Title: 263. Doraemon: Nobita and the Animal Planet
description: What comes to the end of war, unlimited development and environmental destruction.

Title: 264. Prayer of the Rollerboys
description: In a dystopian near future America, a young man infiltrates a powerful drug dealing rollerblading youth gang that runs his town in order to end their reign for good.

Title: 265. Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might
description: A group of aliens visit Earth to plant the Tree of Might, a plant that grants cosmic power by draining the Earth's life force.

Title: 266. Basket Case 2
description: Duane and his basket-bound mutant brother are taken in by a secret home for wayward freaks with journalists hot on their tail.

Title: 267. She Shoots Straight
description: Working in a police precinct full of her in-laws, inspector Mina Kao and her colleagues are assigned a dangerous case involving Vietnamese criminal refugees, right after getting married to her fellow inspector Huang.

Title: 268. Beyond Darkness
description: A minister and his wife move into a haunted house.

Title: 269. The Sleeping Car
description: Jason (David Naughton) moves into an abandoned train car where he resurrects the vicious ghost of his landlady's dead husband - The Mister. After some near-fatal encounters with the violent specter he seeks local exorcist Vincent Tuttle (Kevin McCarthy).

Title: 270. Death at Oslo Central
description: A young boy named Pelle falls in love with the drug addict Lena. Then he and his friend Proffen tries to save her from the drugs.

Title: 271. Stalingrad
description: The WWII pivotal battle of Stalingrad is shown through the eyes of the soldiers and officers on both sides of the war.

Title: 272. Bethune: The Making of a Hero
description: Canadian doctor Norman Bethune joins Mao's army in China, setting up field hospitals and training medics. Flashbacks show his early life, socialist beliefs, medical innovations, humanitarian work in Spain, and marital struggles.

Title: 273. Aaj Ka Arjun
description: Bhim Singh is an orphan who lives a poor life-style in a small community. He is the guardian to his only sister, Laxmi, who he has educated in the city, she meets Ajit Singh the son of Thakur Bhupendra Singh and both falls in love and gets married with the blessings of Bhim, but on there nuptial night, Ajit goes missing. Bhim finds out that Ajit has relocated to his dad's residence and he goes there to beg there pardon but is humiliated and witnesses Ajit knifes Laxmi to death. A grief-stricken Bhim murders Ajit publicly and goes on a rampage to rescue farmers in his community whose land are being snatched by Thakur Bhupendra Singh and his henchman Lakhan.

Title: 274. Agter Elke Man
description: Bruce Beyers is released on parole after serving two years in prison. He is dead set on getting revenge on the man responsible for his conviction.

Title: 275. Pink Ulysses
description: A homoerotic, dreamlike retelling of Odysseus's journey home, blending myth, fantasy, and cinema.

Title: 276. Cellini: A Violent Life
description: The story of Benvenuto Cellini (1500-1571), a soldier and one of the most important craftsmen and artists of Renaissance Italy, whose life was marked by many achievements and adventures, but also crimes.

Title: 277. Genuine Risk
description: A gambler is recruited by his friend to work as a collector for a cold and vicious mobster.

Title: 278. Captain America
description: Frozen in the ice for decades, Captain America is freed to battle against archcriminal The Red Skull.

Title: 279. Caged Fury
description: Discontent leads to a daring escape plan in a women's prison where the inmates are all lingerie clad models and the lesbian warden demands unusual favours for early parole.

Title: 280. Death in Brunswick
description: Down-on-his-luck Carl Fitzgerald meets Sophie, a beautiful Greek girl. He gets a job as a cook, but accidentally kills a fellow worker. He turns to his unscrupulous best friend for help and they attempt to dispose of the body.

Title: 281. Night Eyes
description: A security guard is hired to gather evidence of adultery against the wife of a rock star and ends up getting involved with her.

Title: 282. Layanam
description: The sexual attraction of an older woman towards a young man and their relationship.

Title: 283. Forbidden Love
description: 18-year old-Georg and 13-year-old Barbara played together as children; later, play becomes love, which leads to a catastrophe, as their parents are hostile, leading to a report being filed to the court, as Barbara is underage.

Title: 284. Aashiqui
description: Rahul and Anu fall in love with each other, but before they unite, they have their own problems to deal with.

Title: 285. In the Cold of the Night
description: Scott is a fashion photographer troubled by the sudden appearance of nightmares in his dreams, in which he appears to be involved in the murder of a beautiful young woman.

Title: 286. Flesh Gordon Meets the Cosmic Cheerleaders
description: Flesh Gordon is kidnapped by a group of space cheerleaders hoping to use him to save their planet.

Title: 287. Side Out
description: A law student comes to California for the summer and ends up playing professional volleyball.

Title: 288. Kill Cruise
description: A washed-out German sailor, in a drunken state, agrees to take two British women from Gibraltar to the West Indies in his sail boat. Early into the voyage, they realise that it's not going to be plain sailing.

Title: 289. Kid
description: A mysterious man returns to his former hometown to take revenge on the locals who murdered his parents when he was a boy.

Title: 290. Agneepath
description: A boy grows up to become a gangster in pursuit of the mobster who killed his innocent father, but revenge and reparation may come at great costs.

Title: 291. Tom and Lola
description: Born with severely compromised immune systems, Tom and Lola are two remarkable children confined to sterile plastic enclosures. Yet their irrepressible spirit transcends the barriers of medical equipment and detached hospital staff.

Title: 292. Malizia Today
description: Michel knows Luna, an aspiring dancer, and it is love at first sight. But the boy is also attracted by her mother, which gives more time to the advances of the young.

Title: 293. Shakma
description: Medical students are attacked by an aggressive laboratory animal while locked inside their campus medical building competing in an after-hours role-playing game similar to Dungeons and Dragons.

Title: 294. Shock 'Em Dead
description: Martin is a total loser who makes a deal with the devil to become the greatest rock star in the world.

Title: 295. Ajooba
description: The evil Vizier of Baharistan kills the royal family and takes power himself but the real crown prince, who has survived his machinations, returns to his homeland to avenge his parents as a masked vigilante 'Ajooba'.

Title: 296. Blood Games
description: When an all girl baseball team beats a group of rowdy rednecks from a small town, they soon find themselves the prey in a deadly bounty hunt. Now they are playing for their lives.

Title: 297. Pale Blood
description: A vampire arrives in Los Angeles to investigate a recent series of murders which bear the hallmarks of vampire attacks. Wanting to track down the murderer, he hires a private investigator who herself is obsessed with vampire mythology.

Title: 298. Baby Blood
description: When a strange creature crawls into a woman's uterus she becomes a killer in order to feed the tiny terror growing within her.

Title: 299. Western Lights
description: Young French teens sail Columbus's route from Spain to Yucatan, stopping at Caribbean islands, guided by a few adults aboard their sailing vessel.

Title: 300. Mad Jake
description: Twisted tale about a crazy, preaching redneck named Jake who kidnaps people off the highway and performs sick medical experiments on them. He then proceeds to sell their organs on the black market to Mr. Stone. Everything is fine until he kidnaps the handicapped April and finds that she is harder to control than the others.

Title: 301. The Crawlers
description: People from a small town are attacked by evil radioactive tree roots growing in the forest.

Title: 302. Boiling Point
description: Two disquieted junior baseball players seek revenge on the local yakuza for attacking their coach.

Title: 303. Ruff Sex
description: Three social outcasts who live near the seaside interact with each other in increasingly disturbing ways. The trio of characters are a woman who has killed her sister, a man who enjoys necrophilia, and a female amnesiac.

Title: 304. A Cat in the Brain
description: A horror film director is stalked by a crazed, murderous psychiatrist bent on modeling his kills on the gory death scenes from the director's movies.

Title: 305. China O'Brien
description: A police woman, expert and instructor in martial arts, leaves the city to stay with her dad, sheriff in a town with peace and quiet - or so she thinks. She gets plenty opportunities to show her martial arts skills.

Title: 306. Twilight
description: When a schoolgirl is found murdered in the woods, a retiring detective tries to find her murderer.

Title: 307. Dragon Ball Z: The World's Strongest
description: The Z-Fighters must stop a mad scientist and his assistant that are out to take over the world.

Title: 308. Mister Frost
description: A serial killer gets sent to a mental institution, but as his insidious presence cause the doctors and orderlies to receive strange visions, his psychiatrist tries to find out his true identity.

Title: 309. Playroom
description: An archaeologist is haunted by a nightmare in which his family is murdered.

Title: 310. Ghayal
description: A fiery young boxer's world shatters when his brother is murdered by a ruthless industrialist. Framed for the crime, the wounded fighter breaks free to unleash raw revenge.

Title: 311. Solar Crisis
description: A huge solar flare is predicted to fry the Earth. Astronauts must fly toward the sun to drop a talking bomb at the right time for the flare to be aimed elsewhere.

Title: 312. The Local Stigmatic
description: Two symbiotic sociopaths play obscurely deviant mind games with each other while engaging in perversely brutal acts of violence against victims apparently chosen at random.

Title: 313. Circuitry Man
description: In a pollution-free future, humans seek narcotic chips for pleasure, stealing from Los Angeles with Danner and smuggling to New York, while Plughead pursues them.

Title: 315. Across the Tracks
description: Two brothers: one a drug-dealing layabout, while the other is a hardworking "model son." When the one begins straightening himself out by becoming a high school track star, the other is jealous and retreats into alcohol.

Title: 316. The Last Samurai
description: Following the trail of a samurai ancestor, two Japanese businessmen on a quest for spiritual fulfillment arrive in Africa with a group of tourists, only to get kidnapped by the local guerrilla leader. A tough mercenary must rescue them.

Title: 317. Metamorphosis: The Alien Factor
description: When their security guard father goes missing at the Talos Biology Research Laboratory, siblings Kim and Sherry Griffen go over to the lab to investigate, unaware that he has been killed and eaten, by the most horrific creature that has ever been spawned there. The siblings will soon find themselves in a terrifying battle to defeat and neutralize the evil, before it escapes the lab, and into the outside world.

Title: 318. A Chinese Ghost Story II
description: Following his encounter with the ghosts, tax collector Ling Choi-San gets caught up with a group of rebels and faces a new batch of supernatural terrors.

Title: 319. Abraxas, Guardian of the Universe
description: An alien "policeman" arrives on Earth to apprehend a renegade of his own race who impregnates a woman with a potentially destructive mutant embryo.

Title: 320. Shadowzone
description: Scientists experiment with Extreme Dream Sleep and find a Parallel Dimension. Now they find the door works both ways and something has come through.

Title: 321. No Retreat, No Surrender 3: Blood Brothers
description: Two feuding brothers (one a policeman, the other a martial arts expert) of different political views, join forces to avenge the death of their father, a retired agent, killed by the mafia.

Title: 322. Michael Madana Kama Rajan
description: A comedy of errors with identical quadruplets, separated at birth, coming together as adults.

Title: 323. Prom Night III: The Last Kiss
description: The malevolent spirit of Mary Lou Maloney returns to Hamilton High, where she manipulates a naive male student into helping her wreak havoc on the school.

Title: 324. Sgt. Kabukiman N.Y.P.D.
description: A streetwise New York police officer transforms into the world's most unusual superhuman hero.

Title: 325. The Shrimp on the Barbie
description: Down on his luck and working in a Mexican restaurant in Australia, an American tourist is hired by a icy heiress to pose as an obnoxious new boyfriend in an attempt to make her father accept her current boyfriend.

Title: 326. Rockula
description: A young vampire cannot lose his virginity because of a curse imposed upon him centuries ago.

Title: 327. A Nymphoid Barbarian in Dinosaur Hell
description: In a post-Armageddon world, a young woman finds herself in a fight for survival against mutant cavemen, dinosaurs and other prehistoric animals.

Title: 328. In Harihar Nagar
description: Four young men are enamored by Maya, their next-door neighbor. However, she is in town to investigate the mysterious circumstances surrounding the death of her brother.

Title: 329. Lucrezia Borgia
description: After the death of her husband, Countess Lucrezia Borgia seeks to become the first lady of the Kingdom. To do so, she seduces any influential man with the help of her perverse circle and lead them in a spiral of lust and scheme.

Title: 330. Bad Girls from Mars
description: There's a killer on the set of a sci-fi cheapie, and the new leading lady (Edy Williams) could be next.

Title: 331. Steel and Lace
description: A rape victim returns from the dead to seek vengeance on her rapists.

Title: 332. Killing Spree
description: A man suspects his wife of adultery and goes on a killing spree, eliminating all he believes are sleeping with her, but his victims don't stay dead.

Title: 333. A Moment of Romance
description: During a bank heist, the getaway driver Wah took a young woman Jo Jo hostage. After preventing her from getting killed by his accomplices, they began a forbidden relationship causing mayhem and chaos for their friends and family.

Title: 334. The Suckling
description: A pregnant woman reluctantly goes to an illegal abortion clinic, which also doubles as a brothel, only to have her aborted mutated fetus attack everyone at the clinic.

Title: 335. The King of the Kickboxers
description: A cop goes undercover in Thailand to avenge his brother's death in this martial arts film.

Title: 336. Dil
description: A man pretends to be a rich industrialist to improve his son's chances of marrying in to wealth, but his plan backfires on him.

Title: 337. Deadly Manor
description: A group of young people take refuge in an old, deserted mansion. Soon the members of the group start turning up dead and they realize that they're not alone in the mansion.

Title: 338. Night Angel
description: An evil spirit assumes the disguise of a beautiful young woman, so it can seduce and kill men.

Title: 339. Metamorphosis
description: An anti-aging serum is being developed by a scientist. When he loses his funding he uses it on himself with dire results.

Title: 340. Swordsman
description: A kung-fu manual known as the sacred scroll is stolen from the Emperor's library. An army detachment is sent to recover it. Meanwhile, a young swordsman and his fellow disciple are accidentally drawn into the chaos.

Title: 341. Alienator
description: Kol, an alien escapee, lands in American woods. The commander sends The Alienator to terminate him. Kol joins teens and Ward Armstrong, evading The Alienator's relentless hunt.

Title: 342. Arbor Day
description: When taunted on the 20 year anniversary of his parent's murder, Elmer Jacobs awakens from his catatonic trance to reap a crop of victims- using gardening implements.

Title: 343. A Holy Place
description: Sveto Mesto is based on a literary classic, Nikolai Gogol's 1835 short story, 'Viy'.

Title: 344. Werner and the Wizard of Booze
description: Broesel has to make a Werner animation film but right now he has no real ideas for new stories. Thus he simply draws some stories from Werner's youth.

Title: 345. The Last Island
description: Five men and two women, marooned survivors of an air crash, discover that they may be the only survivors of a world disaster.

Title: 346. Tatar Ramazan
description: The story of a fearless man Tatar Ramazan who believes justice in his own way.

Title: 347. Quiet Days in Clichy
description: Expatriate Henry Miller indulges in a variety of sexual escapades while struggling to establish himself as a serious writer in Paris.

Title: 348. A Tale of Springtime
description: Simple conversations engender complicated human interactions. Jeanne is open and even-tempered, a philosophy teacher at a lycée. Her fiancé is away and she doesn't want to stay at his messy flat; she's loaned hers to a cousin, so she accepts the invitation of Natasha, a music student whom she meets at a party, to sleep in her father Igor's bedroom because he's always with his young girlfriend, Eve. Natasha tells Jeanne a story of a missing necklace and her suspicions of Eve. They all meet at dinner, then again at Igor's country house. Is Natasha scheming to get Igor and Jeanne together alone? Once alone, what determines how they choose to act? And the necklace, what of it?

Title: 349. I Hired a Contract Killer
description: Henri is depressed after losing his job, but finds himself too afraid to go through with suicide. He hires a contract killer to do the job for him instead - but what happens if he changes his mind?

Title: 350. God of Gamblers II
description: Multi talented Cho wants to learn from the God of Gamblers and contacts his disciple. They are attacked by a crime boss with a plan to misuse GoG's good name to make millions.

Title: 351. The End of Innocence
description: Seemingly autobiographical story of a woman overwhelmed with trying to please everyone except herself, and not finding any answers until she's admitted to a rehab center by her parents. Eventually here is where she finds her answers.

Title: 352. Jezebel's Kiss
description: Young woman comes to a small town and starts to take vengeance through seduction and manipulation for the grave injustice that was done to her family a long time ago.

Title: 353. Faces of Death IV
description: Follows the same pattern of the other Faces of Death movies. In this one we see many staged and not so staged looking deaths ranging from bungee jumping accidents and magic tricks gone bad.

Title: 354. Bloodmoon
description: A serial killer is loose at an all girl school, where he strangles girls with a piece of barbed wire.

Title: 355. Mom
description: An L.A. man is shocked to discover that his loving and caring elderly mother has become a vicious monster.

Title: 356. I Bought a Vampire Motorcycle
description: When a motorbike gang kills an occultist, the evil spirit he was summoning inhabits a damaged bike. The bike is then bought and restored, but reveals its true nature when it tries to exact vengeance on the gang.

Title: 357. The King's Whore
description: Set in the seventeenth century, an Italian nobleman weds an impoverished countess, who is wooed by the King of Piedmont and faces pressure from his entire court to succumb to his wishes.

Title: 358. Swarg
description: Krishna is very loyal to his master and treats him like God. Unfortunately, he gets thrown out of the house and the master becomes a pauper. But loyal Krishna returns to change things for the master.

Title: 359. Too Much Sun
description: A multimillionaire whose son and daughter are gay leaves a will with one clause: His children will inherit his money only if at least one of them produces his grandchild within a year of his death.

Title: 360. Ashrita
description: a protesting woman who has being oppressed by her husband's family and the contemporary culture in a male dominated society. At the climax with the help of an Educated family she succeed to give them punishment.

Title: 361. Killer Crocodile 2
description: The Caribbean swamps which is to be made into a holiday resort is terrorized again by a second monstrous crocodile which is killing off anyone unfortunate to be on the water.

Title: 362. Anne of Green Gables: Road to Green Gables
description: Anne is an orphan full of imagination. When she arrives at her new home she learns that sometimes you have to be a sensible person too; at the same time her unique character changes, or at least attracts, the people around her. The story covers Anne's growth from about eleven to seventeen years old as she makes friends, goes to school and studies. At a difficult point in her life, Anne will have to make a hard choice and perhaps find a new dream.

Title: 363. The Big Steal
description: To impress a girl, a shy teenage boy buys a used Jaguar.

Title: 364. Tonight at Alice's
description: Saverio and Filippo are two friends and religious leaders of a travel agency in Rome. However, Filippo has trouble with his wife, because she finds out that he cheated on her with a comely girl named Alice.

Title: 365. Mondo Weirdo
description: Young girl becomes Alice in dreamland during menstruation. Wild dreams and nightmares about sexuality, vampirism, death, obsessions and other bizarre things.

Title: 366. L'Autrichienne
description: Last days of queen Marie Antoinette stunningly portrayed by a director who's clearly done a massive historical research. An accurate plot and a very moving rendering.

Title: 367. Naked Obsession
description: A city councilman explores the seedy side of town to help him decide how to approach an urban renewal project. Being obviously not from the area, he is knocked out in the street and both his car and his wallet are stolen. A mysterious and charismatic transient helps him out and guides him into the sordid world surrounding a strip tease dive, and eventually he has an intense affair with one of the strippers. Then the stripper is murdered and he is implicated in the crime. Now, he must try to clear his name.

Title: 368. Naked Rage
description: Gianni's career threatened when his wife Angela fakes assault. With lover Eva, they plan Angela's murder. Blackmailed by witness, Angela has loyal maid Rosy and a mysterious man around.

Title: 369. Mother
description: How a mother acts in the hardest parts of her, and her children's lives.

Title: 370. A Gnome Named Gnorm
description: A Los Angeles police detective partners up with a talking gnome in order to bring down the head of a crime ring.

Title: 371. Qatil Jawani
description: Widower Shamji lives a wealthy lifestyle in Southern India along with his son, Arun, and owns a private college named after his deceased wife, Nirmala. When Arun comes of age, he arranges his marriage with Singapore-based Archana, the daughter of his widower friend, Ketan Sharma. Arun and Archana meet and approve of each other, and shortly thereafter both get married. On the night of the marriage, their house gets broken into by an unknown male who wants to rob Archana's gold and jewelry. When Arun tries to stop him, a scuffle ensues, Arun gets stabbed and is killed. Archana dons the garb of a widow and Shamji permits her to run the college. Shortly thereafter four outstanding male students go missing one by one. Their overly anxious parents approach Archana, who in turn asks the local police for assistance. The question remains where are the four students, and how and why did they disappear?

Title: 372. Time Barbarians
description: A medieval warrior chases a bad guy to modern day Los Angeles to avenge the death of his wife.

Title: 373. Maniac Nurses find Ecstasy
description: Bizzare, often perverse yarn about nurses in a metropolitan hospital who seduce then murder male patients.

Title: 374. Highway to Hell
description: Mass-murderer Toby Gilmore escapes from prison, and the open desert becomes his playground. An officer sets out in pursuit, and the chase hurtles across backroads, each mile bringing them closer to a reckoning on the highway to hell.

Title: 375. Midnight Ride
description: A house wife just left her cop husband, when she picks up Justin Mckay she'll wish she never did as she's plunged into a nightmare and the grip of a psychotic killer.

Title: 376. Bullseye!
description: Two scientists working for UK and USA invent cold fusion. They decide to auction it off to foreign nations. Two look-alike crooks decide to steal their deposits but end working for CIA and MI5.

Title: 377. Grim Prairie Tales
description: Travelling across a prairie, a cynical Old West bounty hunter and a clerk try to top each other's ghost stories around the campfire.

Title: 378. The Rainbow Thief
description: A petty crook in search of the clichéd pot of gold at the end of the rainbow hopes to cash in by befriending the heir to a huge fortune.

Title: 379. Watchers II
description: A fugitive Marine finds a genetically re-engineered dog psychically linked to a deadly monster created in a lab experiment gone awry. The man, the dog, and a lab assistant come together to stop the escaped monster's rampage.

Title: 380. Skinned Alive
description: This is the tale of a crazed family of weirdos led by Crawldaddy who like to kill people and remove their skin.
